core.headline: First & second floor maisonette, Streatham High Road, SW16
core.summary: Own entrance to this two-bedroom maisonette with bay-fronted living room and kitchen fitted in 2022. Section 42 lease extension notice served and can be assigned. Close to Streatham station and Streatham Common.
core.listing:
A first and second floor maisonette above a commercial unit, accessed via its own entrance from the rear service yard. The bay-fronted living room measures 4.90m x 4.10m into bay and the kitchen was fitted in 2022. A Section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer.

Accommodation comprises a bay-fronted living room and kitchen measuring 3.20m x 2.30m on the first floor. On the second floor are two bedrooms – bedroom one 3.85m x 3.05m and bedroom two 2.70m x 2.40m – and a bathroom.

Access to the rear service yard is shared with the commercial unit, and there is a shared bin store. There is no parking; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approximately 6 minutes' walk and Streatham Common approximately 10 minutes' walk.

The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road; some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below.

Offers in Excess of £375,000. Leasehold, 89 years remaining. Ground rent £350 per year (doubles every 25 years; next increase 2034). Service charge £960 per year (year ending December 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C (London Borough of Lambeth). EPC rating D. Construction: standard – brick under a slate roof. Electricity, water and sewerage are mains. Heating is by gas combination boiler. FTTP broadband is available. Rights and easements: access via rear service yard shared with the commercial unit; shared bin store. No known issues relating to building safety, restrictions, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility or coalfield/mining.
